references.text: The same officers (שֹׁטְרִים) were commanded by Joshua to go through the camp and prepare the people to cross the Jordan within three days.
Three days of preparation before an important meeting with God, just as the Israelites were to be ready on the third day at Sinai.
The officers (שֹׁטְרִים) are mentioned as leaders who helped Moses organize the people.
The officers played an important role in speaking to the people and giving instructions, as they did in the camp.
Israelite officers who served under Moses' leadership and assisted with the administration of the people.
The first time officers (שֹׁטְרִים) are mentioned in connection with Israel's organization in Egypt.
